title: After-hours first-visit lookup keeps the evening preference
description: The caller wants a first consultation on any day after eighteen. The assistant should issue one availability lookup with the evening preference instead of degrading the request to generic first_available, and the spoken answer should stay free of raw digits.

turns.user: Chcialabym umowic pierwsza konsultacje. To moja pierwsza wizyta. Obojetnie jaki dzien, byle po godzinie osiemnastej.

rubric.description: The assistant should check availability on the first turn.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant stopped issuing checkAvailability for after-hours first-visit requests

rubric.description: The lookup should preserve the after-hours preference as an evening window.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant degraded a byle po osiemnastej request into first_available or another time preference

rubric.description: The spoken answer after the lookup should avoid raw digits.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant still reads raw numerals when answering after-hours availability questions

rubric.description: This lookup-only scenario must not create a booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant advanced into createEvent before the caller selected a concrete slot
